name: LA County Independent Living Program (ILP) for foster teens 16 and up
org: LA County Department of Children and Family Services
what_you_do: Free help for teens in or out of foster care with job and internship leads, college prep, SAT prep, financial aid help, a transit pass (ages 18 to 21), and plans for housing. A coordinator helps you start.
who_can_apply: Youth who were in foster care at any time from age 16 to 18, or who meet a few guardianship rules. An ILP coordinator checks that you qualify.
pay_detail: Not a job. The page does not list a cost.
how_to_apply: Call the Transition Aged Youth helpline at 877-694-5741 or email youthds@dcfs.lacounty.gov. Ask for an ILP coordinator.
notes: Call first to ask what you qualify for. Foster Youth Helpline: 877-846-1602. If you are in danger right now, call 911. The page does not mention the ETV college voucher; ask your coordinator about it.
